gist.headline: Across 148 comments the conversation is mostly positive: 41.2% positive, 48.6% neutral, 10.1% negative (average sentiment score 0.166).
bullets: Biggest topic: Services & grooming details — 42 comments (28.4% of all comments). Example: "Beautiful salon, lovely staff, my dog always comes back happy."
What people loved: Praise & love — 10 of its 11 comments are positive. Example: "Absolutely love this place! My golden retriever came back smelling amazing and looking so handsome."
Main complaint theme: Complaints — 3 negative comments in this theme. Example: "Still no reply to my message from Thursday about prices. Very frustrating."
Biggest repeated demand: 9 comments ask versions of the same thing (Price questions). Representative comment: "How much do you charge for puppy's first groom?"
